dessin:
On the left (x 5-46%, y 22-80%): a tall pale legend cartouche (map legend box) with a thin double rule near its top, leaving an empty header band. Inside, along its left edge (x 8-14%), three small symbol boxes stacked vertically, each a small square frame: at y 33% a tiny format sheet with a map pattern; at y 46% a round seal with a double ring (a standard); at y 59% a tiny software window with a title bar. To the right of each symbol, an empty line. Below the third symbol, two more empty lines (y 66% and 73%).
On the right: a pale format sheet with a simple map pattern (parcels and a road) at x 56-68%, y 24-44%.
A small pale unnamed format sheet with a different pattern (green vegetation hatching) at x 84-94%, y 30-46%.
A blue route (#2F6DA8, round caps) goes from the bottom of the first sheet down to an empty spot at x 62%, y 56%, and a red route (#C4472B, round caps) goes from that empty spot up to the small green sheet. Keep a free empty space of 260 by 120 px centered at x 62%, y 58% (a logo will be placed there by code).

elements.legende: the tall legend cartouche on the left with its symbols
elements.symbole-format: the first small symbol box (tiny format sheet) in the legend
elements.symbole-norme: the second small symbol box (round seal) in the legend
elements.symbole-logiciel: the third small symbol box (tiny software window) in the legend
elements.saif: the format sheet with parcels and a road on the right
elements.route-lire: the blue route going down from the format sheet
elements.route-ecrire: the red route going up to the small green sheet
elements.feuille-autre: the small sheet with green vegetation hatching
